title: Map and tasks
note: M opens and closes this screen over the running round (press, not hold; rebindable, #211); Tab does nothing here. The mouse is freed while it is open and the player keeps walking: only the mouse look stops. Nothing here is a HUD hint: the map never shows players, items, roles, teammates or done points. The MVP: the five MVP task types, the House's rooms, Delivery's zones gone and the zone highlight kept for the MVP tasks; the pin 42 px and the you-are-here chip clear of it. Every length the old x 1.5, the panels kept inside the frame. Input while it is open: the gameplay actions keep working (move, sprint, jump, interact, talk), so Space, which jumps, must never press a focused «?»: remove Space from ui_accept in the project InputMap (Enter and the gamepad's A still press; jump keeps Space), and when the card was opened with the mouse, closing it releases focus instead of giving it back to the «?». The map's focus moves only with the arrows and the d-pad; the left stick and WASD walk.

states.label: Задачі
states.note: The task list beside the map; nothing hovered, nothing focused.

states.label: Наведено на задачу
states.note: The mouse is over the Cooking row (no look of its own): the map lights that task's zones, the kitchen here (sample data); the zone fills the room under its head.

states.label: З клавіатури
states.note: The same from the keyboard or gamepad: an arrow or the d-pad gave Cooking's «?» focus, which shows its ring and lights the zones as hovering the row does. The only frame of this screen that shows a focus ring.

states.label: Натиснуто «?»
states.note: Cooking's «?» was pressed: its how-to card opens over the map (own-work Delivery frames as a placeholder; the card holds as many frames as its task needs and scrolls sideways); Close, Esc or M closes it.

nodes.name: Dim
nodes.note: mouse_filter IGNORE. The round keeps running behind it.

nodes.name: Tasks
nodes.note: 60 px in, 624 wide (the old 80 and 608 kept near: x 1.5 would leave the frame); grows down from its top to its content (the rows, then the time). On open no control has focus (state list); the first ui_down or ui_up gives focus to the first row's «?», which lights that task's zones (state keyboard; the mouse over a row lights them with no focus, state zone). While the how-to card is open, focus_behavior_recursive = FOCUS_BEHAVIOR_DISABLED here (see Dim2).

children.name: Title
children.note: The tile's head in small capitals (the target's tile heads); the game sets uppercase = true.

children.name: Rows
children.note: Hairline rows (ToySettingRow), 4 px apart.

children.name: CarTuning
children.note: One row per task type the round deals (the MVP's five: car tuning, the ship's engine, cooking, photo, Wi-Fi), in the round's task order. A counter only, never a description: what counts is each task type's data (the car's order cards, the engine's stages, the burgers, the photo, the Wi-Fi's N passwords). Hovering a row or focusing its «?» lights the task's zones.

children.name: Count
children.note: The task's progress of the round's total; updates live while the map is open.

children.name: Help
children.note: The text ? is a glyph, not a deck key (auto_translate_mode DISABLED); focus_mode ALL. 63 x 63 (the old 42 x 1.5) so it stays round at large text. A press opens this task's how-to card (Guide); keyboard focus shows the task's zones as hovering the row does. Every ? looks the same (no seen or new mark).

children.name: Help
children.note: As the first row's Help.

children.name: Cooking
children.note: mouse_entered and mouse_exited (and focus on its «?») show and hide this task's zones on the board (Kitchen/V/Area/Zone, ZoneTag).

children.name: Help
children.note: As the first row's Help.

children.name: Help
children.note: As the first row's Help.

children.name: Help
children.note: As the first row's Help.

children.name: Time
children.note: The round's time left, m:ss, updated every second.

nodes.name: Board
nodes.note: 732 to 1860 across, 60 to 1020 down: 48 px right of the task list, 60 px in. While the how-to card is open, focus_behavior_recursive = FOCUS_BEHAVIOR_DISABLED here (see Dim2).

children.name: Rooms
children.note: Children are built from the level's map data (room rects, the pin), scaled to fit this rect. The rects here are sample data in Rooms px (1116 x 948) until the House's map exists. Open: whether the map shows the capsules or the mutation workbench; the map never marks a mischief while the hint rule is open.

children.name: Lab
children.note: One room: its rect from the map data, its name as the head at the top left and its system B pictogram centred. Sample rooms of the House; the pictograms that fit them stand in (the garage takes the workshop's, the pantry the storage's, the study the office's, the living room the lounge's) until the House's rooms have their own; a room without one shows only its name.

children.name: V
children.note: The room as a quiet tile: its name in small capitals as the head at the top left (ToyKicker; the game sets uppercase = true), its system B pictogram (72 px, the old 48 x 1.5, in the dim colour of its head: the pack's tint_color, ui-2.2.0) centred in the rest of the room.

children.name: Area
children.note: The room under its head: the pictogram centred in it, and the lit zone filling it (Kitchen/V/Area/Zone).

children.name: Zone
children.note: mouse_filter IGNORE. A lit zone of the hovered or focused task (level or content data): a zone that is a whole room is the first child of the room's Area, so it fills the room under its head; a zone that is part of a room is placed the same way inside it by its rect. Cooking lights the kitchen here (sample data). Zones never light a hidden thing (nothing hidden is found by highlighting, GDD §8).

children.name: ZoneTag
children.note: mouse_filter IGNORE. Under the first zone's room, its left edge on the room's, 18 px below it (the old 12 x 1.5).

children.name: Pin
children.note: You are here: the local player's position from the map data, 42 px (its size constants; the old 28 x 1.5). pivot_offset_ratio (0.5, 0.5); rotation = PI / 4 + the player's heading on the map (0 = up, clockwise), so the sharp top-left corner points where the player looks. Updated every frame while the map is open.

children.name: Here
children.note: Follows the pin: its left edge 21 px right of the pin's rect (the 9 px a turned pin's corner reaches past its rect, then 12 px), its centre on the pin's centre line; it does not rotate.

nodes.name: Dim2
nodes.note: mouse_filter STOP: the task list and the map under the card do not react to the mouse while it is open. Keyboard and gamepad focus search ignores what is drawn on top, so while the card is open set focus_behavior_recursive = FOCUS_BEHAVIOR_DISABLED on Tasks and Board (Control, Godot 4.5+) and restore FOCUS_BEHAVIOR_INHERITED on close. The card handles ui_cancel and the map key itself and calls get_viewport().set_input_as_handled(), so one press closes only the card, never the map too.

nodes.name: Guide
nodes.note: Centres the how-to card of the task whose «?» was pressed (content data per task type, #254) on the screen. Close, Esc (ui_cancel) or M closes it; focus goes back to that «?» only when the card was opened by keyboard or gamepad. mouse_filter IGNORE (Dim2 blocks the mouse).

children.name: Card
children.note: The same card tree as s3/Card and the Esc menu's s5 Guide/Card (Head, Scroll/Frames/Frame1..7, each holding its Art), plus Bar with Close; it takes its content's width, the Scroll's 1384 px.

children.name: Head
children.note: The card's head as a tile head: howto.label in small capitals over the task's name.

children.name: Note
children.note: The game sets uppercase = true.

children.name: Scroll
children.note: The frames scroll sideways when they do not fit (the engineer, 2026-10-22): a card holds as many frames as its task needs. No bar is drawn (SCROLL_MODE_SHOW_NEVER) until the pack has a sideways bar; the frame cut at the card's edge shows there is more. The wheel scrolls it sideways while vertical scrolling is disabled, a drag on a touch screen too (unconfirmed for Godot 4.7.2: check ScrollContainer's wheel handling); follow_focus true. The view shows three and a half frames (1384 px), as s3's.

children.name: Art
children.note: PLACEHOLDER art: seven own-work Delivery frames (dist/pack/cards/delivery-meaning-1..3, delivery-1..3 and delivery-meaning-4, 640x480, transparent) stand in for the Cooking card's seven frames, which the engineer named every card's placeholder (2026-10-22). Those frames are generated art kept in the art track (prime-game-art#272) and this repo's licence list does not cover generated art yet, so the game takes them from the art track's pack. expand_mode IGNORE_352x264 here and in s3, 272x204 in s5's Guide, stretch_mode KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED; SIZE here; the same card in s3, s5 and s8. The cards are wordless: a frame holds only its art, no caption.

children.name: Frame7
children.note: The frame that shows the finish.

children.name: Close
children.note: Takes focus when the card opens by keyboard or gamepad, with the ring hidden until the next arrow or d-pad press (grab_focus(true), Godot 4.5+; unconfirmed for 4.7.2); opened with the mouse, nothing has focus.
